name: Retirement contribution sketch
audience: People who want to see how a monthly contribution and an assumed rate interact before they speak to a fund or adviser.
summary: Project a savings balance from a contribution and an assumed return you type in.
description: The future value uses the rate you enter. It is an illustration, not a forecast and not a retirement-fund quote. Fees, tax, and inflation are not modelled.
benefits: See the balance an assumed rate produces
Change the rate without hiding that it is an assumption
Keep the current savings separate from new contributions
compatibility: Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021 and later
Formulas also open in Google Sheets; confirm PMT, FV, and NPER after import
PDF guide opens in any PDF reader
DOCX guide opens in Microsoft Word or Google Docs
disclaimer: This workbook organises figures you type in. It is not financial, credit, insurance, or tax advice. Rates, fees, and laws change. A qualified adviser should review decisions that affect debt, tax, medical cover, or retirement.
